name: Vision Dinner Countdown
source: Fundraising Masterminds Perfect Vision Dinner model, with LEAD settled standards (see the playbook).
date_rule: Due date = dinner_date + offset_days. If offset_days is missing, it is -7 × weeks_out.

groups.weeks: Weeks 21 to 1, titled 'Week N · <Mon D>' using dinner_date - 7N days

tasks.name: Set the dinner goal and guest target
tasks.details: Pick a guest target (e.g., 150) and a giving goal. First-dinner benchmark: a $25K match pool supports about a $100K goal.

tasks.name: Run the Table Leader math
tasks.details: Guests ÷ 10 = tables; × 2 = Table Leaders to recruit; × 3 = names to name-storm. 150 guests → 15 tables → 30 Table Leaders → 90 names.

tasks.name: Schedule the name-storming party
tasks.details: About 90 minutes. Invite staff, board, volunteers, donors, past Table Leaders and networkers. Hold it Week 19.

tasks.name: Draft the 5-Year Dream Vision and 3–5 SMART goals
tasks.details: Feeds the accelerators (Week 11). Core values, dream vision 'if finances were not a problem', estimated cost, then SMART goals.

tasks.name: Start a matching-gift prospect list
tasks.details: Engage the critical few early. Qualifier: $1,200 or $100/mo. Lead gifts $5K+ each.

tasks.name: Confirm the date against conflicts
tasks.details: Working date Sat Mar 6, 2027. Check other nonprofits' events, school/campus events, holidays, key partners, Table Leaders, keynote and appeal speaker.

tasks.name: Shortlist and tour 3 venues
tasks.details: Upscale 'date night' venue, separate reception space, stage on the long wall, high ceilings, no pillars, easy parking. Use the venue inspection checklist. Plan 30–50% growth room.

tasks.name: Build the dinner budget
tasks.details: Budget Guide worksheet. Food $30–50/plate + ~25–29% service + tax; AV $1.5–5K; print $1–2/person; décor; honorariums. Board approval if needed.

tasks.name: Negotiate the venue
tasks.details: Negotiation Script. Start from lunch pricing and portions; plated; pre-set salad and dessert; 6–8 oz beef; own AV allowed; professional servers; no alcohol; parking, power, Wi-Fi.

tasks.name: Sign the venue contract (only after per-plate price and F&B minimum are set)
tasks.details: Contract checklist: guarantee date, overset %, price lock, tax/gratuity formula, room waiver, cancellation, parking, billing. Deposits only; balance after the event.

tasks.name: Set the Saturday run-of-show times
tasks.details: Reception 5:45–6:30 · doors 6:20 · done about 8:15. 2:15 max including the meal.

tasks.name: Hold the name-storming party
tasks.details: Ground rules: everyone agrees to fill a table; whoever names someone calls them. Criteria: within 1 hour, loves Jesus and the mission, knows 3–4 couples. Prime with professions.

tasks.name: Set up the Table Leader Recruiting tracker
tasks.details: Name, who's asking, phone, email, asked?, confirmed?, registered?, packet delivered?, last contact, # at table, notes.

tasks.name: Begin Table Leader invite calls
tasks.details: Table Leader invite script. Send the Pre-Call Letter first for weaker relationships. Get each Table Leader's email when they say yes.

tasks.name: Recruit the Host Committee
tasks.details: 6–8 well-known people who are ALREADY Table Leaders. One per profession; no pastors or politicians. Listed on the invitation (name, title, organization).

tasks.name: Recruit the Overall Dinner Coordinator
tasks.details: Strong delegator; owns timeline, print, speaker coaching, scripts and thank-yous. 4 Key Roles job descriptions.

tasks.name: Recruit the Table Leader Coordinator
tasks.details: Leads a team of 4–6 to recruit, train and care for Table Leaders; helps plan seating.

tasks.name: Recruit the Registration Coordinator
tasks.details: Runs the registration system, check-in, name tags, dietary and seating questions.

tasks.name: Recruit the D.O.V.E.
tasks.details: Director of Volunteer Efforts: mailings, décor, testimonies, speaker logistics, night-of volunteers.

tasks.name: Start the weekly 30-minute dinner team call
tasks.details: Same time every week through the dinner.

tasks.name: Final venue contract check
tasks.details: Everything negotiated is in writing; F&B minimum vs expected attendance; outside AV allowed without penalty; no hidden costs.

tasks.name: Build the program timeline (AIC, 2:15 max)
tasks.details: Welcome 3 · prayer · dinner 45 max · honored guests 5 · update video 3 · Ministry Update 13 · Appeal Pt 1 7 · creative 5 · testimonies 3×3 · keynote 19 · Appeal Pt 2 5 · close.

tasks.name: Recruit the keynote speaker
tasks.details: Lesser-known proven communicator who knows and loves LEAD; humor + emotion + data. Honorarium $500 (LEAD standard).

tasks.name: Draft the day-of pre-event schedule
tasks.details: Setup from about 1 pm (5–6 hours); program team meeting and volunteer training 1 hour before guests arrive.

tasks.name: Finalize the design theme across all pieces
tasks.details: One theme for web banner, save-the-date, invitation set, Don't Forget card, program, slides, giving envelope (Vision Dinner Spec Sheet).

tasks.name: Update postcard front and registration banner to the new date
tasks.details: Both still show Oct 24, 2026. Hold printing until date and venue are final.

tasks.name: Calculate print counts
tasks.details: Table Leaders × 10 per piece + up to 600 mailed. Print-materials worksheet.

tasks.name: Build the targeted mailing list (~600)
tasks.details: Best partners who gave in the last 12 months, within a 60-minute drive.

tasks.name: Build the registration page at leadcma.org/dinner
tasks.details: Register button and QR code for print. Replaces FundEasy.

tasks.name: Build the Vision Dinner Monday boards
tasks.details: Vision Dinner Guests and Table Leaders boards in this folder, linked to All Contacts (master record).

tasks.name: Build the registration form
tasks.details: Hidden email lookup in All Contacts (update or create), plus-one with own email and 'same address' pre-checked, seating dropdown of confirmed Table Leaders + 'I like making new friends.'

tasks.name: Decide the Contact Type wording at registration
tasks.details: Open item: 'March 2027 Vision Donor' at registration, or 'Vision Dinner Guest' at registration plus 'Vision Donor' after the gift import.

tasks.name: Set up dinner email sequences in Monday
tasks.details: Confirmation, save-the-date email, e-invitation, Don't Forget, week-of reminders.

tasks.name: Draft the BEO
tasks.details: Drafting Your BEO worksheet. Saturday: dinner 6:30, entrées 6:40, last entrée 7:00; clear salads per person; one coffee pour; all staff leave before the program.

tasks.name: Add the attire line to the registration page and emails only
tasks.details: 'Business Attire is strongly suggested: Men – Suit or Jacket/Tie. Women – Dress or Pants Outfit.' Not on print.

tasks.name: Get AV quotes and book a professional AV company
tasks.details: Never the venue's AV. Sized to the room, own operators. Use the A/V Equipment Checklist.

tasks.name: Review the save-the-date, invitation and Don't Forget designs
tasks.details: Final proof before ordering print.

tasks.name: Order print: save-the-dates, invitations, Don't Forget cards
tasks.details: Quantities from the Week 16 print counts.

tasks.name: Prepare the Table Leader packet contents
tasks.details: Intro letter, invitation checklist, How to Invite & Register sheet, 10 save-the-dates, 10 invitations, 10 Don't Forget cards, 9×12 envelope.

tasks.name: Hold the Table Leader packing party
tasks.details: Volunteers assemble packets.

tasks.name: Recruit Church Champions
tasks.details: 1–2 per supporting church who lead a table AND recruit other Table Leaders.

tasks.name: Define ZIP ranges and buy stamps for the save-the-date mailing
tasks.details: 60-minute drive radius.

tasks.name: Secure the matching gift fund (5 × $5K)
tasks.details: Lead gifts committed before the dinner, given at or after (ECFA). Guests qualify at $1,200 or $100/mo.

tasks.name: Convert any past sponsors into matching-gift partners
tasks.details: Thank them, explain leveraged generosity (3–5× impact), ask them to redirect the same amount or more into the match. Call them partners.

tasks.name: Recruit and train the calling team
tasks.details: 1 caller per 15 Table Leaders. Train with role-play; give read-only access to registrations.

tasks.name: Milestone: 50% of Table Leaders recruited
tasks.details: Never stop recruiting Table Leaders.

tasks.name: Deliver Table Leader packets
tasks.details: Hand-delivered within 24–48 hours of each yes.

tasks.name: Mail the save-the-date postcard
tasks.details: To the targeted list (~600), same week packets go out (LEAD standard).

tasks.name: Callers make first calls to Table Leaders
tasks.details: 3–5 days after packets arrive. Walk through Table Leader responsibilities. Then every other week until 4 weeks out.

tasks.name: Follow up with recruiters who haven't made their asks
tasks.details: Address fear of calling.

tasks.name: Write the 3 accelerators
tasks.details: $25K–$150K+ each. 'Accelerator #1: $X — Two-Word Title — [action] [how] [SMART impact]'. Fit on one slide.

tasks.name: Confirm all 7 speaking roles
tasks.details: Emcee, Ministry Update, appeal speaker (board chair), 2 changed-life testimonies, partner testimony, prayer. Keynote confirmed Week 17.

tasks.name: Write the Vision Dinner Narrative
tasks.details: Template doc: theme, message, 3–5 priorities, strategies, opportunities.

tasks.name: Produce the Ministry Update video (3 min)
tasks.details: History and problem, 20,000-ft view, short testimony snippets, no current asks.

tasks.name: Plan the creative pieces
tasks.details: 5 min max each, 3 total including the update video.

tasks.name: Plan the reception
tasks.details: Punch and water stations, no hors d'oeuvres, space for 50%+ of guests, sell nothing before the appeal.

tasks.name: Write the Ministry Update (13 min)
tasks.details: Problem 1 · Who we are 2 · How God is using us 2 · Opportunities 3 · 3 Accelerators 5. Named stories, no giving levels. Edit out loud. Required closing line introduces the appeal speaker.

tasks.name: Send the save-the-date email
tasks.details: Monday sequence.

tasks.name: Send the Keynote Speaker Guideline Letter
tasks.details: Customized.

tasks.name: Resume Table Leader recruiting (second 50%)
tasks.details: Spring dinners recruit the second half from about Jan 2.

tasks.name: Plan the WOW factor
tasks.details: Signage from the parking lot, programs on chairs, centerpieces with table numbers, riser, podium, backdrop, welcome slides.

tasks.name: Choose the table giveaway
tasks.details: One branded item per table; a red dot under one program marks the winner. Not a raffle.

tasks.name: Prepare time cards and countdown app; choose the timekeeper
tasks.details: 5 / 3 / 1 / STOP (LEAD standard). Timekeeper in clear view of the podium.

tasks.name: Budget honorariums and tips
tasks.details: Keynote $500 · emcee $100 · ODC $100 · Table Leader, Registration and D.O.V.E. coordinators $50 each · banquet captain $100. Others get a handwritten thank-you.

tasks.name: Train Table Leaders on managing their table
tasks.details: How to register guests and see their table on the registration system.

tasks.name: Start late-print designs
tasks.details: Giving envelope, program, Table Leader Giving Packet, signage, name tags.

tasks.name: Write the giving opportunities slide
tasks.details: ~7 lines tied to accelerators: $600/$50 · $1,200/$100 · $2,400/$200 · $4,800/$400 + 2–3 of $12K–$72K. Level ÷ unit cost = impact.

tasks.name: Fill in the appeal script (verbatim)
tasks.details: FMM Financial Appeal Script. Part 1: 7 min; Part 2: 5 min (LEAD standard). Same speaker both halves.

tasks.name: Send the Financial Appeal Packet to the appeal speaker
tasks.details: Cover letter, both scripts, training video.

tasks.name: Send electronic invitations
tasks.details: Monday sequence.

tasks.name: Finalize the giving envelope and program for review
tasks.details: Envelope follows the template exactly.

tasks.name: Recruit and coach 2 changed-life testimonies
tasks.details: 3 min each, live. Changed-Life Testimony Guide.

tasks.name: Recruit and coach the partner testimony
tasks.details: Consistent giver, not a pastor, not a couple. Partner Testimony Guide.

tasks.name: Mail printed invitations to the targeted list
Create the run sheet for key personnel
Prepare the 6 thank-you letters
tasks.details: One-time · 90-day · 12-month · one-time AND monthly · attended, no gift · registered, didn't attend. Mail-merge fields.

tasks.name: Schedule the Thank-You Party and list its volunteers
tasks.details: Morning after the dinner: sort, merge, print, stuff, stamp, call.

tasks.name: Assign next-day thank-you callers
tasks.details: Every $600+ or $50/mo+ giver.

tasks.name: Ministry Update final draft done
tasks.details: Finish by 5 weeks out.

tasks.name: Set the room layout and serpentine table numbers
tasks.details: Stage on the long wall. Table 1 front left; rows alternate direction. Mirror it in the registration system.

tasks.name: Order giving envelopes and programs
tasks.details: #10 envelope; programs on heavy cardstock.

tasks.name: Assemble Table Leader Giving Packets
tasks.details: Labeled 9×12 with name and table number: attendance sheet, Day-Of Guidelines, 10 giving envelopes, 10 pens. Handed out at registration.

tasks.name: Recruit greeters (6–8)
tasks.details: Line of sight from one to the next, from the parking lot to registration.

tasks.name: Recruit ushers and a Chief Usher
Recruit registration workers
tasks.details: 1 table + 2 workers per 150 guests, plus a Special Registration table.

tasks.name: Recruit counters (4–8) and a Counting Coordinator
tasks.details: Trusted staff/board, not greeters or ushers.

tasks.name: Recruit the setup and teardown crew
Testimony scripts due to the D.O.V.E.
tasks.details: D.O.V.E. hears each one at least once.

tasks.name: Move Table Leader calls to weekly
tasks.details: Full tables (6+) can stay every other week.

tasks.name: Set up online check-in with a paper-list fallback
Set the meal guarantee
tasks.details: Guarantee Table Leader-assigned guests only. Plan 10–12% no-shows minus the venue's 3–5% overset. Don't tell the venue.

tasks.name: Send volunteer letters and job descriptions
tasks.details: Arrival time and who to report to.

tasks.name: Train greeters, ushers and registration workers
tasks.details: Registration: the 4 kinds of arrivals (pre-registered, Table Leaders, unassigned, walk-ins).

tasks.name: Book the photographer
tasks.details: Photographer Cheat Sheet.

tasks.name: Finalize the program and the 6 thank-you letters
'Fish or cut bait' calls to every Table Leader
tasks.details: Confirm who is really filling their table before the guarantee.

tasks.name: Merge and split tables
tasks.details: Close registration first. Largest group's Table Leader leads a merged table.

tasks.name: Give the guarantee; finalize and sign the BEO
tasks.details: Signed by both sides; carry copies on the night.

tasks.name: Consolidate and edit all scripts
tasks.details: One message that celebrates the Lord. Master script for AV.

tasks.name: Build the slides
tasks.details: One file, videos local, content in the top two-thirds of the screen.

tasks.name: Set up the gift counting sheet and train counters
tasks.details: 6 tabs = the 6 letter types. Counters work in pairs.

tasks.name: Send the program to the printer; send the Don't Forget email
Close public registration at capacity +5% if needed
tasks.details: Waitlist and backfill from cancellations.

tasks.name: Set seating
tasks.details: Program participants, major partners and VIPs up front; timekeeper in the podium's view.

tasks.name: Finalize the emcee script and minute-by-minute schedule
Decide the cut list (plan to end 5 minutes early)
Print run sheets (20) and the signed BEO
Prepare honorariums and tips
tasks.details: LEAD amounts (see Week 8).

tasks.name: Print name tags and paper attendance backup
tasks.details: Table number and Table Leader indicator.

tasks.name: Confirm AV equipment and load-in time
tasks.details: Load-in at least 2–4 hours before doors.

tasks.name: Email staff and volunteers final logistics
tasks.details: Arrival times, pre-event meetings, address, dress code, parking.

tasks.name: Schedule the 5 week-of reminder emails
tasks.details: Mon 1 pm · Wed 7 pm · day before 11 am · morning of 8 am · 2 hours before doors. Address, map link, schedule.

tasks.name: Work through the Final Packing Checklist
Reminder email: Wednesday 7 pm
tasks.details: Add 'come dressed in your best'.

tasks.name: Reminder email: 2 hours before doors
tasks.details: Directions.

tasks.name: Download check-in data and print paper lists before leaving
Venue setup (key coordinators and AV 3 hours before)
Brief the banquet captain with the BEO and timeline
tasks.details: You control the timing, not the venue.

tasks.name: Speaker walkthrough and volunteer briefing
tasks.details: Speakers 20–30 min before doors; volunteers 1 hour before guests.

tasks.name: Collect every envelope; count in a private room
tasks.details: Get the quick total that night.

tasks.name: Videotape the dinner
tasks.details: Even an iPhone on a stand.

tasks.name: Thank-you calls to every $600+ or $50/mo+ giver
tasks.details: Next day.

tasks.name: Thank-You Party: letters out the door in 24
tasks.details: Saturday dinner → mailed Monday.

tasks.name: Process cards and bank info; black out numbers
tasks.details: Within 12 hours of processing.

tasks.name: Import gifts and update contacts in Monday
tasks.details: Update Contact Type per the decision made in Week 16.

tasks.name: Debrief and evaluate
tasks.details: Attendance, no-show rate, giving per person and per table, AND gifts, cost per guest (night-of costs only).

tasks.name: Rate the keynote and pick next year's date
Start monthly Faith Promise reminder letters
tasks.details: Insider-style: reminder + appreciation + story or prayer request.

tasks.name: Plan year-round Table Leader cultivation
tasks.details: Multiplication, not replication.
